record_scope_reconstruction: Honduran Agua Caliente checkpoint closure and staged freight readmission are distinct from Guatemala retaining its own closure. October23 phase only concerns preauthorized drivers entering Honduras from Guatemala.

source_checks.finding: October20 EFE report quotes INM temporary Agua Caliente closure after caravan crossing.
October23 INM announcement allows only prechecked authorized freight drivers from Guatemala; other routes normal.
October24 reports Honduran customs services restored while Guatemala still maintained closure; does not imply full paired-border reopening.

Road tags explicitly name Carretera Ocotepeque–Agua Caliente CA10, with named customs node embedded.
Official migration directory identifies Agua Caliente in Ocotepeque on Guatemala border.
